- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that a password policy is a set of guidelines designed to ensure password security.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed best practices for creating a password policy, including:
  - Password complexity requiring a mix of upper and lower case letters, numbers, and special characters.
  - Password length of at least 8 characters.
  - Password expiration after a set period, such as 90 days.
  - Password history preventing reuse of old passwords.
  - Requirement of two-factor authentication for all users.
  - Regular training and education on password security best practices.
  - Secure storage of passwords using strong encryption.
  - Regular auditing of the password policy.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a comprehensive reply summarizing best password policy practices and guidelines, citing multiple sources for reference.
